items.title: Bitcoin Price Climbs Above $86,000
items.summary: Bitcoin surged above $86,000 on Monday for the first time since January. The largest cryptocurrency recently traded around $86,516 as of 4 p.m. ET, up 7% from its 4 p.m. ET level on Friday. Crypto-linked stocks, including Coinbase Global and Strategy, also moved higher Monday morning in tandem with bitcoin.
